about: Flood spots in Bengaluru named in news reports (scripts/news/). Each report links its source; summaries are our own words, at most 15 words, never article text. Positions come from OpenStreetMap names (ODbL) or Nominatim. count = distinct flood days reported (dates within 2 days count once). Coverage follows the news: busy roads are over-represented.

discovery: GDELT DOC 2.0 API (when not rate limited)
